Description

Send messages into space from students in the public school system of the Maranhão municipality, in an effort to bring quilombola communities closer to space activities.

Developed by UFMA in partnership with AEB, the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), and the startup PION, the device will also undergo tests with national communication systems, energy, solar panels, and an onboard computer. strengthening the Brazilian space industry supply chain.
